item.summary: Hilbert Group on 23 November 2026 published its interim report for the third quarter of 2026. The Stockholm-listed digital-asset investment firm reported a loss of SEK 44.4 million for the quarter, an 18 per cent improvement on the loss of SEK 54.3 million a year earlier, with earnings per share of SEK −0.34 (against SEK −0.66) and equity of SEK 8.0 million (against SEK −0.7 million). Fee-paying assets under management, excluding the Xapo mandate, rose 55 per cent in the quarter to USD 92.7 million at 30 September, of which USD 14.4 million was net new capital from clients. The company notes that reported revenue is not directly comparable with the third quarter of 2025 because of a change in accounting presentation, including the treatment of Enigma’s proprietary trading result.
